text:
TACOB AL-YAWN AL-AAMM
Tatamayaz yawmuka al-yawm bi-taqa mushriqa wa muheetah tu'azziz min huzoorika al-malaki ya burj al-asad. Yujlibu lakal-yawm furasan ra'i'ah li-ta'zeez thiqatika bi-nafsiqa wa 'indikas-sira'at al-yawmiyyah sawfa tajid nafsaka al-qa'id al-mutabee'. Al-halah al-mazajiyyah 'aaliyah jiddan wa tumtali' bil-tafa'ul, مما yaj'aluka mahatt al-anzar ayna-ma zahabta. Ishtahi hadha al-yawm bi-qalb maftooh wa rouh ijabiyyah, fa al-kawn yad'amuka li-tahqeeq ma tatamanna-hu.

AL-HUBB WA AL-ILAQAT
Lil-murtabiteen, hadhal-yawm huwa al-waqt al-amthal li-tajdeed al-shrarah fi al-'alaqah al-zawjiyyah aw al-'atifiyyah 'abr mufaja'ah basheetah aw hiwar 'ameeq ya'zizu al-tawasol al-qulbi. Amma lil-uzzab, fa al-falk yushir ila ihtimaliyat liqa' ghayr mutawaqa' qad yughayyir majra yawmika wa yanshur al-frah fi qalbika al-kabir. La tat تردد fi tawtheeq al-mashair al-sadiqa, fa al-sihr al-asadi yajzib al-qulub bila majhood.

AL-AMAL WA AL-KARIYAR
Fi majal al-'amal, tatamayaz al-yawm bi-injazat kabirah wa qudrah fareedah 'ala idarat al-mahaam al-sa'bah bi-hikmah wa shaja'ah. Qad tatajm'u hawlaka al-zumaala' li-talb al-mushwarah aw al-da'm, fa kun al-qa'id al-mullhim alladhi ya'rif kayfa yuwajjihi al-umoor nahwa al-najah. Ibtamid 'an al-ta'attul wa istaghil kull lahdah li-ithbat nafsika wa tarqeeyat mashrou'atika al-mustaqbaliyyah.

AL-MAL WA AL-BARAKAH
Al-wad' al-maali yashhad istiqrarun malhoozan ma' furas jadidah lil-dakhil al-ihafi aw isthmarat mustaqbaliah najihah. 'alayka bi-al-ta'addul fi al-masroufat wa tajannub al-ishraaf al-za'id al-ladhi la da'i lahu, wa likin la taqlaq fa al-rizq qadim bi-kull yusr. Ishtammar hadha al-waqt li-tanzim mizaniyyatika wa wad' khuttah maliyyah thabitah li-fatrah al-qadimah.

AL-SIHHA WA AL-TAQA
Al-taqa al-jasadiyyah wa al-dihniyyah 'inda quwwatiha al-yawm, مما yumkinuka min mumarasah nashatatika al-yawmiyyah bi-nashat wa hayawiyyah. Unsayz 'ala ahammiyyat al-ihtimam bil-riyadah al-khafifah wa shurb al-maa' bi-kammiyyat kafiyah li-hafiz 'ala nadhrat jismika. Al-raha al-nafsiyyah mutawaffirah, fa istaghil dhalik fi mumarasah al-taammul aw al-istijmam ba'id 'an daqaiq al-zahmat.

AL-TAWASOL WA AL-MUJTAMA'
Al-a'ilah wa al-asdiqa' yantadhiruna wujoodaka al-dafi' wa ibtisamatika al-mushriqah li-nashr al-bahjah fi al-makan. Al-khurooj fi nuzhah ijtima'iyyah aw liqa' ma'a al-muqarrabin sayun'ashu rouhaka wa yumtali'u yawmika bil-dahk wa al-dhihriyyat al-jamilah. Istami' bi-inssat li-ashaarihim, fa wujooduka yumnuhum al-da'm al-nafsiyyah al-kabeer.

NASIHAT AL-YAWM
Dha 'amalaka yatahadhath 'anka, wa la taqlaq bi-sha'n al-naqd al-saghyr, fa al-shams la tahtaj ila ithbat annaha tumdi' al-kawn.

TAFASEEL AL-YAWM
Al-raqm al-mahzouz: 5
Al-lawn al-mahzouz: Al-zahabi al-lami'
Al-burj al-mutawafiq: Burj al-qaws
